title: POLCA — Power Oversubscription in LLM Cloud Providers
summary_zh: 在生產規模上刻畫 LLM 推理的功率，揭示計算受限的 prompt 階段會將 GPU 推至功率上限（並導致頻率削減），而記憶體受限的 token 階段則不會——推理尖峰功率利用率僅 79%（訓練為 97%）。POLCA 以雙閾值、面向優先級的反應式控制器（先對低優先級 GPU 設限 SM 時脈）回收這部分餘裕，並以 SM 時脈設限換取功率：至多回收 20% 尖峰功率，延遲代價至多僅 7%。模擬顯示同一功率受限叢集可多部署 30% 的推理伺服器。對我們的預測器而言，這是時脈項與負載及階段相關的資料中心級證據。
summary_en: Characterizes LLM inference power at production scale, showing that the compute-bound prompt phase drives the GPU to its power cap (and thus a frequency cut) while the memory-bound token phase does not — inference peaks at only 79% of provisioned power versus 97% for training. POLCA reclaims this headroom with a dual-threshold, priority-aware reactive controller that caps low-priority GPU SM clocks first, trading SM-clock frequency for power: up to 20% of peak power reclaimed for at most a 7% latency cost. Simulation deploys 30% more inference servers in the same power-constrained cluster. For our predictor, it is the datacenter-scale evidence that the clock term is load- and phase-dependent.
